newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kingspan says 99.30 pct of issue taken up.
newsitem.headline: Kingspan says 99.30 pct of issue taken up.

text.p: Irish building materials group Kingspan Group Plc said on on Thursday that 99.3 per cent of rights issue shares offered to shareholders on December 12 had been taken up.
Kingspan said the issue of 4,688,608 new ordinary shares at 440 Irish pence had been been taken up to the extent of 4,655,960 ordinary shares.

Those ordinary shares not taken up were sold on Thursday by the company's brokerage firm, Riada, at a premium of approximately 124 Irish pence per ordinary share over the rights issue price of 440 pence, Kingspan said.

It said this premium will be remitted, in accordance with the rights issue, to the persons to whom such ordinary shares were provisionally allotted, except that amounts of 300 Irish pence or less will be aggregated and retained for the benefit of the company.
